title: HTTP Access Log - Log Contract v1
description: Contract cho bronze layer: moi dong JSONL sinh ra boi traffic simulator (generator/) va duoc doc boi Spark ingest job phai tuan theo schema nay.

log_id.description: UUID4, duy nhat cho moi dong log - dung de dedup khi ingest.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC, do chinh xac milisecond. Vi du: 2026-01-15T10:23:45.123Z

query.description: Chuoi query string tho (khong bao gom '?'). Null neu request khong co query param.

session_id.description: UUID4 nhom cac request cung mot 'phien' (visitor session hoac attack burst).

label.description: Nhan ground-truth do trinh sinh log gan, dung de huan luyen/danh gia model phat hien bat thuong.

attack_id.description: UUID4 nhom tat ca cac dong log thuoc CUNG mot chien dich tan cong. Bat buoc la null khi label == 'normal', va bat buoc khac null khi label != 'normal'.
